title: EvoGraph-Mem: Failure-Aware Editable Graph Memory for Long-Term Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.11248v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term memory is essential for language agents operating across extended interactions and evolving tasks. Existing memory-augmented agents mainly focus on storing and retrieving past experience, but the quality of stored memories may degrade over time. In particular, previously distilled insights can become outdated, over-generalized, or harmful under new task contexts, causing memory pollution when repeatedly reused. To address this issue, we study insight-level memory maintenance for long-term language agents and propose a failure-aware memory maintenance framework based on an editable insight graph. Each insight node tracks positive evidence, negative evidence, and an activation state, enabling the agent to distinguish reusable insights from conflicting or invalid ones. We further introduce a utility-aware retrieval mechanism and a graph controller that updates the memory graph after task execution by keeping reliable insights, arc

translated_title: EvoGraph-Mem：面向长期语言代理的故障感知可编辑图记忆
translated_abstract: 长期记忆对于在扩展交互和不断演变的任务中运行的语言代理至关重要。现有的记忆增强代理主要侧重于存储和检索过去的经验，但存储记忆的质量可能随时间推移而下降。特别是，先前提炼的见解可能在新任务情境下变得过时、过度概括或有害，导致反复使用时产生记忆污染。为解决此问题，我们研究了长期语言代理的见解级记忆维护，并提出了一种基于可编辑见解图的故障感知记忆维护框架。每个见解节点跟踪正面证据、负面证据和激活状态，使代理能够区分可复用的见解与冲突或无效的见解。我们还引入了一种效用感知检索机制和一个图控制器，该控制器在任务执行后通过保留可靠见解来更新记忆图。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于可编辑见解图的故障感知记忆维护框架，通过跟踪证据和激活状态来识别并清理过时或有害的记忆，从而防止长期语言代理的记忆污染。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a failure-aware memory maintenance framework based on an editable insight graph, which tracks evidence and activation states to identify and clean outdated or harmful memories, thereby preventing memory pollution in long-term language agents.
